description: Changes one rule that decides how a booking platform's or form relay's notices are recognised and routed, as the rule editor's Save does: rule_id, then any of name, sender_pattern (*@domain), subject_pattern, source_label, priority, is_active, routing_mode, routing_behavior, use_block_format, event_kind ('client_message' makes it a relay source, 'other' does not). A duplicate sender+subject is refused with the rule that owns it. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: update_platform_email_rule
title: Change a platform email rule
